title: Never Outshine the Master
summary: Be careful not to make people above you feel insecure or threatened by your abilities. Show your strengths while respecting their position.

title: Never Put Too Much Trust in Friends, Learn How to Use Enemies
summary: Choose relationships carefully. Friendship does not always guarantee reliability, while a former rival may sometimes become a useful ally.

title: Conceal Your Intentions
summary: Do not reveal every plan or intention immediately. Think carefully about what information should be shared and when.

title: Always Say Less Than Necessary
summary: Communicate clearly and avoid unnecessary talking. Saying less can help you remain composed and avoid revealing information unnecessarily.

title: So Much Depends on Reputation — Guard It With Your Life
summary: Your reputation strongly affects how others perceive and treat you. Build credibility and protect it through consistent behavior.

title: Court Attention at All Costs
summary: Being noticed can influence how people perceive your presence and value. Learn to communicate your strengths without becoming disruptive.

title: Get Others to Do the Work for You, but Always Take the Credit
summary: Use collaboration and delegation effectively, while making sure contributions are recognized fairly and responsibilities are clear.

title: Make Other People Come to You — Use Bait If Necessary
summary: Instead of always chasing opportunities, create value or incentives that encourage others to approach you.

title: Win Through Your Actions, Never Through Argument
summary: Strong results often communicate more effectively than arguments. Demonstrate your ability through actions and evidence.

title: Infection: Avoid the Unhappy and Unlucky
summary: The attitudes and behaviors of people around you can influence your mindset. Maintain healthy boundaries with consistently negative influences.

title: Learn to Keep People Dependent on You
summary: Develop useful skills and reliability so that your contribution remains valuable to a team or organization.

title: Use Selective Honesty and Generosity to Disarm Your Victim
summary: Honesty and generosity can build trust, but they should be used thoughtfully and ethically in relationships.

title: When Asking for Help, Appeal to People's Self-Interest
summary: When requesting help, explain how the situation can also benefit the person you are asking.

title: Pose as a Friend, Work as a Spy
summary: Pay attention to useful information in your environment, but respect privacy and avoid deceptive or harmful behavior.

title: Crush Your Enemy Totally
summary: Resolve serious conflicts decisively rather than leaving problems that may repeatedly return. In modern situations, this means addressing the root cause.

title: Use Absence to Increase Respect and Honor
summary: Constant availability can reduce perceived value. Appropriate space and boundaries can increase appreciation.

title: Keep Others in Suspended Terror: Cultivate an Air of Unpredictability
summary: Avoid becoming completely predictable. Flexibility and controlled uncertainty can help you respond effectively to changing situations.

title: Do Not Build Fortresses to Protect Yourself — Isolation Is Dangerous
summary: Completely isolating yourself can reduce information, support, and opportunities. Maintain useful connections with others.

title: Know Who You're Dealing With — Do Not Offend the Wrong Person
summary: Understand the personality, position, and context of the people you interact with before making important decisions.

title: Do Not Commit to Anyone
summary: Avoid making unnecessary commitments too quickly. Maintain independence when a situation requires careful evaluation.

title: Play a Sucker to Catch a Sucker — Seem Dumber Than Your Mark
summary: Sometimes appearing less knowledgeable can make others reveal more information. Use this principle cautiously and ethically.

title: Use the Surrender Tactic: Transform Weakness Into Power
summary: When direct resistance is not effective, stepping back can create time and space to regain strength and choose a better strategy.

title: Concentrate Your Forces
summary: Focus your time, energy, and resources on important goals instead of spreading yourself too thin.

title: Play the Perfect Courtier
summary: Use emotional intelligence, respect, diplomacy, and good communication when working with people who have influence.

title: Re-Create Yourself
summary: Do not let old labels define you. Intentionally develop your identity, skills, and personal image.

title: Keep Your Hands Clean
summary: Protect your credibility by taking responsibility for your actions and avoiding unnecessary involvement in questionable behavior.

title: Play on People's Need to Believe to Create a Cultlike Following
summary: People naturally seek meaning and belonging. Build communities through genuine value rather than exploiting people's vulnerabilities.

title: Enter Action With Boldness
summary: Once you have evaluated a decision, confident action can be more effective than constant hesitation.

title: Plan All the Way to the End
summary: Think beyond the immediate step and consider possible outcomes, risks, and consequences before acting.

title: Make Your Accomplishments Seem Effortless
summary: Good preparation allows you to present your work clearly and confidently without showing unnecessary struggle.

title: Control the Options: Get Others to Play With the Cards You Deal
summary: When presenting choices, structure them around realistic options that support the overall goal.

title: Play to People's Fantasies
summary: Understand what people hope for and value, while communicating ideas in a way that connects with their aspirations.

title: Discover Each Man's Thumbscrew
summary: Understand what motivates different people. Knowing their priorities can help you communicate and negotiate more effectively.

title: Be Royal in Your Own Fashion: Act Like a King to Be Treated Like One
summary: Carry yourself with confidence, dignity, and self-respect so that others understand the standards you set for yourself.

title: Master the Art of Timing
summary: Good decisions depend not only on what you do but also on when you do it.

title: Disdain Things You Cannot Have: Ignoring Them Is the Best Revenge
summary: Do not waste energy obsessing over things outside your control. Focus attention on achievable goals.

title: Create Compelling Spectacles
summary: Strong visual presentation and memorable experiences can make ideas easier for people to notice and remember.

title: Think as You Like but Behave Like Others
summary: Keep your independent thoughts while understanding social norms and adapting your behavior appropriately.

title: Stir Up Waters to Catch Fish
summary: Emotional situations can reveal useful information, but creating unnecessary conflict can cause harm. Stay calm and observant.

title: Despise the Free Lunch
summary: Be cautious about offers that appear completely free. Understand the hidden costs, obligations, or expectations.

title: Avoid Stepping Into a Great Man's Shoes
summary: Do not simply copy a successful predecessor. Build your own strengths and identity while learning from those before you.

title: Strike the Shepherd and the Sheep Will Scatter
summary: In group conflicts, understanding the central source of a problem can help resolve the wider situation.

title: Work on the Hearts and Minds of Others
summary: People respond strongly when they feel understood and respected. Build trust by understanding their needs and perspectives.

title: Disarm and Infuriate With the Mirror Effect
summary: Reflecting another person's behavior or communication style can reveal patterns and change the dynamics of an interaction.

title: Preach the Need for Change, but Never Reform Too Much at Once
summary: People often accept change more easily when it is introduced gradually. Balance improvement with stability.

title: Never Appear Too Perfect
summary: Showing some humility and acknowledging that nobody is perfect can make you more relatable and trustworthy.

title: Do Not Go Past the Mark You Aimed For; In Victory, Learn When to Stop
summary: After achieving a goal, recognize when further action could create unnecessary risk. Know when enough is enough.

title: Assume Formlessness
summary: Stay adaptable instead of becoming trapped by one fixed strategy. Adjust to changing circumstances.
